products.title: BSP Female Swivel 60° Cone Crimp Fitting for Braided Hose
products.descriptionShort: BSP Female Swivel 60° Cone crimp hose fitting for braided hydraulic hose (1SN · 2SN · R1AT · R2AT · R16 · R17). Indus-branded equivalent of the Parker 19243 series, in 7 sizes from -04.
products.descriptionLong:
The BSP Female Swivel 60° Cone Crimp Fitting for Braided Hose is a one-piece crimp hose fitting for braided hydraulic hose — EN 853 1SN and 2SN, and SAE 100R1AT, 100R2AT, 100R16 and 100R17. It is supplied under the Indus Hydraulics brand and is dimensionally interchangeable with the Parker 19243 series.

Construction

  • Configuration: straight
  • Thread form: BSP parallel (G) thread
  • Sealing form: 60° cone seat
  • Gender: female-swivel
  • Material: carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated (316 stainless on request)

Hose compatibility

Crimps onto EN 853 1SN and 2SN, and SAE 100R1AT, 100R2AT, 100R16 and 100R17. Pair it with the matching Indus crimp ferrule for the hose grade — the ferrule, not the fitting, is what changes between hose constructions. The assembly's pressure rating is set by the hose grade and bore, not by this fitting.

Parker equivalence

This listing replaces the Parker 19243 series. Individual sizes are listed below with our part number alongside the Parker number they replace, so you can order from an existing bill of materials without re-specifying.

Sizes

7 sizes, hose bore -04 to -20. Full size and dimension table on this page.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number for the size you need, or send us the Parker number and we will cross it. Tell us the hose grade and bore and we will include the matching ferrule. Indus crimps and pressure-tests assemblies before dispatch — send the overall length and both end fittings on the RFQ.

faqs.answer: 45° flare seat, metal-to-metal. Pair it with the matching counterpart — a mismatched sealing form will seat but will not hold pressure.

faqs.question: What is the maximum working pressure?
faqs.answer: The hose grade and bore set the assembly rating, not the fitting. A correctly crimped fitting does not derate the hose. Look up the pressure at your bore on the hose grade you are using, or tell us the grade and bore on the RFQ and we will confirm it in writing.

faqs.question: Which ferrule pairs with this fitting?
faqs.answer: The one that matches your hose grade — 4SP · 100R12 covers several constructions and the skive/no-skive choice follows the hose, not the fitting. Send the hose grade with your enquiry and we will specify the ferrule and the crimp diameter.

faqs.question: Is stainless steel available?
faqs.answer: Yes — 316 stainless on request across the range, for marine, offshore and washdown service. Standard supply is carbon steel, zinc-plated and Cr3+ passivated. Add "-SS" to the part number when you enquire.

faqs.question: Can Indus crimp the assembly?
faqs.answer: Yes. We crimp, pressure-test and certify assemblies in Dubai and ship UAE-wide. Send the hose grade, bore, both end fittings, overall length and orientation, and we will quote the finished assembly rather than loose parts.
